items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Did Milt Hinton’s grandmother bring him up? Or was it his mother?

ctx.x: Same with Milt Hinton. He said almost the same scenario. Because they came up to Chicago in small numbers so that they would send money home and the rest of them could come.
Did Milt Hinton’s grandmother bring him up? Or was it his mother?
I think it was his mother, yeah.
